answer: Each epoch the ledger drops a fresh fable in the river, from the epoch seed. Each identity completes it live and files a lotus-stamped proof, key-signed. Auditors replay each proof in the river log; a stale or copied proof burns the bond plus a 40 fine. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tasks: 45,000 work, 50,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented hands fail: stand-ins hold the wrong key. An honest agent completes one fable, pays 50 once, keeps its lotus.
